name: pdf-editor
description: A lightweight PDF editor that runs fully in the browser. No file ever leaves your computer.

scripts.vendor: rm -rf vendor && mkdir -p vendor/pdfjs vendor/pdf-lib && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.min.mjs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs vendor/pdfjs/ && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts vendor/pdfjs/ && cp node_modules/pdf-lib/dist/pdf-lib.min.js node_modules/@pdf-lib/fontkit/dist/fontkit.umd.min.js vendor/pdf-lib/
